22 bones including hand grip sockets; normalized maximum-four influences; nine in-place motions. Locomotion follows measured stance speed.

Adult female cat-eared kunoichi, 1.68 m tall, covered dark primitive outfit. Katana cut impact at 267 ms; separately verified equipment and game contact QA follow body adoption.
